copy.tagline: 为卡片添加复古蓝图风格的装饰效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在设计中加入蓝图网格和锈红奶油色调的卡片元素。
copy.tagline_en: Add retro blueprint-style decorative effects to cards.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add blueprint grid and rust-red cream tones to card designs.

howto.what: Claude 会用蓝图纸纹底、锈红标注、黑边硬卡片和 pipeline 步骤盒来生成架构或流程讲解幻灯片，版式为 16:9，整体是严肃、适合印刷的工程风。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作架构或 pipeline 流程讲解类幻灯片，或点名使用这个蓝图风格模板时触发。

say.text: 用蓝图架构模版把我们的服务调用流程做成一张讲解页
say.note: 会生成带 pipeline 步骤盒的蓝图风格幻灯片

say.text: 按 deck-blueprint 风格设计系统架构说明页
say.note: 得到黑边硬卡片和锈红注释的架构图

say.text: 把这段部署流程排版成蓝图风幻灯片
say.note: 流程会以步骤盒加反馈环的形式呈现

howto.what_en: Claude will generate architecture or pipeline explanation slides using a blueprint grid background, rust-red callouts, black-bordered hard cards, and pipeline step boxes, in 16:9 format, with a serious print-friendly engineering look.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for slides explaining architecture or pipeline flows, or explicitly requests this blueprint-style template.

say_en.text: Use the blueprint template to turn our service call flow into an explainer slide.
say_en.note: Produces a slide with pipeline step boxes in blueprint style.

say_en.text: Design a system architecture page in deck-blueprint style.
say_en.note: Gives hard black-bordered cards and rust-red callouts.

say_en.text: Lay out this deployment workflow as a blueprint-style slide.
say_en.note: Flow appears as step boxes with a feedback loop.
